narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000016 — THE DATA COLOSSEUM

Fifty thousand simulated spectators roar as streams of tokens fly.

Tonight the dome hosts Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker (hybrid) against Tax Organizer (domain). Judging: The Scholar's Rubric. The mission: "Write a dialogue between a clock and a calendar." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker counters a cascade of examples (65.1 pts). Tax Organizer counters a lightning analogy (60.5 pts). Round to Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker.

ROUND 2: Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker weaves a feint of pure logic (69.8 pts). Tax Organizer presses the attack a volley of reasoning (56.1 pts). Round to Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker.

ROUND 3: Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker steadies a precision strike of clarity (54.4 pts). Tax Organizer counters a surge of structured thought (62.5 pts). Round to Tax Organizer.

FINAL: Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker defeats Tax Organizer, 189.3 to 179.1 — a margin of 10.2 points. A stunning upset: the underdog takes the dome!

Decisive edge: Evidence. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

UPSET: Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker entered as the statistical underdog and won anyway — adaptability beat raw power.

Hybrid vigor confirmed: the fused lineage (Mix-and-match hybrid of Dating Profile Helper (JAH-AI-DOM-153) and Allergy Checker (JAH-AI-DOM-083). Shared record with the AI Mix Lab.) outperformed both parent archetypes tonight.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Scholar's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Accuracy 35%, Depth 25%, Clarity 20%, Evidence 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000016, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker's evidence-first drill for "Write a dialogue between a clock and a cal"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on evidence when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Dating Profile Helper x Allergy Checker's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000016: isolate evidence, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
